items.t: Swimmer Zhang Yufei Fires Back at Critics After Asian Games Gold
items.s: China's Zhang Yufei defended her 50m butterfly title at the Nagoya Asian Games, then hit back at online critics who said she was too old to keep competing. China's medal haul also passed 95 golds.

items.t: Teenager Breaks Asian Games 100m Record as China's Sprint Stars Survive Scare
items.s: A 20-year-old Thai sprinter shattered Su Bingtian's Asian Games 100m record with 9.91 seconds, while China's Xie Zhenye and Zeng Keli both advanced to a tense final in Nagoya.
